title: The Hall of Clocks
text: A hall of a thousand clocks, from the floor to the high dark ceiling, each telling a different time, each ticking at its own pace. The noise is like rain. One of them, small and black, is ticking backward, and the hands on your own heartbeat seem to follow it.

outcomes.text: Time catches up all at once, and carries you a long way ahead.
Time catches up with you, and it has been waiting.

options.label: The wisest listens to the ticking.

outcomes.text: All thousand clocks are counting down to the same thing.
Silence, at last, and something that was waiting for the silence.
